hook.name: EvpEquityRewardTaxHook
hook.description: Collects a 0.7% tax on the equity quote token for swaps in six EVP/equity pools (EVP paired with MSFT, SPCX, SPY, TTWO, HIMS, or MU). Only exact-input swaps are allowed; buy-side fees are taken upfront in beforeSwap, sell-side fees in afterSwap. Accrued fees can be permissionlessly swept to an immutable vault.
